spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export PYTHONPATH=/root/autodl-tmp && cd /root/autodl-tmp && python -m freige.training.dpo_trainer --dpo_data_path /root/autodl-tmp/dpo_data/dpo_pairs.jsonl --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/dpo_output --learning_rate 2e-5 --per_device_batch_size 1 --gradient_accumulation_steps 16 --wandb_run_name plan_012_dpo_ced"

experiment_data.hypothesis: DPO+CED preference learning: 用 CED 构造 preference pairs (CED top-1 = chosen, CED bottom-1 = rejected)，DPO 训练。验证 offline preference optimization 能否替代 online GRPO 避免 catastrophic forgetting，同时利用 CED 信号。对比 RSFT (rel_f1=0.46) 和 SFT baseline (rel_f1=0.4057)。
